exercises.q: That will teach you a lesson.
exercises.why: **научит** — научи́ть (perfective): to teach (often not in an academic setting). Wiktionary: на- + учи́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **изучали** — изуча́ть (imperfective): to study, to learn (implying that an individual or a group is studying or learning something with an in-depth approach); to familiarize oneself with, to master. Wiktionary: изучи́ть + -а́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to learn (often not in an academic setting)
to teach (often not in an academic setting)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ученик — school student, schoolboy, pupil; научи́ться — to learn (often not in an academic setting); научи́ть — to teach (often not in an academic setting); изучи́ть — to learn, to study.
**выучил** — вы́учить (perfective): to learn (to completion, typically something involving rote memorisation); to memorize. Wiktionary: вы́- + учи́ть.
